faqs.question: What is OfferEvo?
faqs.answer: OfferEvo is a local deals platform where customers create offers for businesses they like. The business approves each offer before it goes live, and then anyone can find, share and use it.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to browse offers?
faqs.answer: No. You can browse the feed, open any offer and view public profiles without signing in. You need an account to save, create or redeem an offer.

faqs.question: How do I create an account?
faqs.answer: Open app.offerevo.com and sign in with Google. Your account is created the first time you sign in.

faqs.question: Can I sign up with an email and password?
faqs.answer: Not currently. Google is the only sign-in method.

faqs.question: Is OfferEvo free?
faqs.answer: Yes, for both customers and business owners.

faqs.question: Do I need to download an app?
faqs.answer: No. OfferEvo runs in your browser. You can also install it to your home screen, which makes it behave like an app.

faqs.question: How do I install OfferEvo on my phone?
faqs.answer: Open app.offerevo.com in your browser and choose Add to Home Screen. On Android an install prompt usually appears on its own.

faqs.question: Does OfferEvo work on a computer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Everything works on desktop, though redeeming is designed for a phone since you show a code in store.

faqs.question: Do I need one account for both customer and business use?
faqs.answer: One account is enough. Adding a business to your existing account gives you the business tools alongside everything else.

faqs.question: Is there a separate business app?
faqs.answer: No. The business tools appear in the same app once you add a business.

faqs.question: Which browsers are supported?
faqs.answer: Any current browser. Some features, such as sharing an image straight to another app, depend on what your browser supports.

faqs.question: Why does sharing only offer to download the image on my computer?
faqs.answer: Desktop browsers do not accept image sharing, so OfferEvo saves the file and copies the caption instead. On a phone the normal share sheet opens.

faqs.question: Is OfferEvo available in my country?
faqs.answer: OfferEvo is open to anyone. What you see depends on whether businesses near you have joined.

faqs.question: What does it cost a business to join?
faqs.answer: Nothing. Adding a business and approving offers is free.

faqs.question: Who can create an offer?
faqs.answer: Any signed-in user can create an offer for any business listed on OfferEvo.

faqs.question: How do I create an offer?
faqs.answer: Tap the plus button, search for the business, then write the offer and its conditions and submit it for approval.

faqs.question: Can I create an offer for a business that is not on OfferEvo?
faqs.answer: No. The business has to be on OfferEvo first, because it has to approve the offer before it goes live.

faqs.question: How long can the offer headline be?
faqs.answer: 42 characters. The form shows a live counter.

faqs.question: How long can the conditions be?
faqs.answer: 120 characters.

faqs.question: Why is the headline so short?
faqs.answer: Offers are shown as cards in a feed, and a short headline keeps every card readable at a glance. Use the conditions field for the detail.

faqs.question: What should I put in the conditions?
faqs.answer: Anything that limits the offer, such as which days it applies on, times, or what has to be bought. For example, on weekdays before 11am.

faqs.question: Can I choose the offer's category?
faqs.answer: No. The category comes from the business and cannot be changed on an individual offer.

faqs.question: Can I choose the offer's colour?
faqs.answer: Only if the business allows it. Some businesses lock their brand colour, and then every offer for them uses that colour.

faqs.question: What colours can I pick?
faqs.answer: Any colour. If a colour would be hard to read in light or dark mode, OfferEvo adjusts its brightness for that mode only and keeps your colour everywhere else.

faqs.question: How many redemptions can I set?
faqs.answer: Up to the maximum the business allows. Some businesses fix a single number, others let you choose from a range up to their cap.

faqs.question: What does it mean when the redemption count is locked?
faqs.answer: The business has chosen a fixed number, so every offer for them allows exactly that many redemptions.

faqs.question: How long can an offer run?
faqs.answer: Up to the maximum number of days the business allows. As with redemptions, some businesses fix it and others let you choose.

faqs.question: When does the countdown start?
faqs.answer: When the business approves the offer, not when you submit it. An offer waiting for approval is not using up its days.

faqs.question: Can I edit an offer after submitting it?
faqs.answer: No. Offers cannot be edited. If something is wrong, archive it and create a new one.

faqs.question: Can I delete an offer I created?
faqs.answer: You can archive it, which removes it from everywhere public. Archiving is permanent and cannot be undone.

faqs.question: How many offers can I create?
faqs.answer: There is no limit on how many you submit. Each one still needs the business to approve it.

faqs.question: Can I create an offer for my own business?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can post for a business you own and approve it yourself.

faqs.question: Can two people create the same offer for one business?
faqs.answer: Yes. The business decides which ones to approve.

faqs.question: Do I get anything for creating an offer?
faqs.answer: Your name and handle appear on the offer card, and your public profile lists the offers you created.

faqs.question: Can I make an offer that never expires?
faqs.answer: No. Every offer has a set number of days and ends when that runs out.

faqs.question: What happens after I submit an offer?
faqs.answer: It goes to the business as pending. It is not visible to anyone else until the business approves it.

faqs.question: How long does approval take?
faqs.answer: It depends entirely on the business. OfferEvo does not set a time limit on reviewing an offer.

faqs.question: How do I know if my offer was approved?
faqs.answer: Open My Deals. Approved offers move to the Approved tab and become visible in the feed.

faqs.question: Why was my offer rejected?
faqs.answer: The business decides. If they left a reason it is shown on the offer in the Rejected tab of My Deals.

faqs.question: Can I appeal a rejection?
faqs.answer: There is no appeal process in the app. You can create a different offer for the same business.

faqs.question: Can a business change an offer instead of rejecting it?
faqs.answer: No. A business can approve or reject an offer, not edit it.

faqs.question: Can an offer go live without the business approving it?
faqs.answer: No. Approval by the business is the only way an offer becomes visible.

faqs.question: Can a business un-approve an offer that is live?
faqs.answer: Not directly. A business can archive itself, which pauses all of its offers.

faqs.question: Does a rejected offer stay in my account?
faqs.answer: Yes, under the Rejected tab in My Deals, with the reason if one was given.

faqs.question: Can I resubmit a rejected offer?
faqs.answer: Not the same one. Create a new offer instead.

faqs.question: Who sees my offer while it is pending?
faqs.answer: You and the business owner. It does not appear in the feed, in search or on your public profile.

faqs.question: How do I find offers near me?
faqs.answer: The feed shows live offers for your city. Open OfferEvo and they are the first thing you see.

faqs.question: How does OfferEvo know where I am?
faqs.answer: It uses your location if you have already allowed it, otherwise the city on your profile, otherwise an approximate city from your internet connection.

faqs.question: Will OfferEvo ask for my location?
faqs.answer: Not on its own. The feed never triggers a location prompt unless you tap the location button yourself.

faqs.question: The feed shows the wrong city. How do I fix it?
faqs.answer: Tap the location chip at the top of the feed to use your device location, or set your city on your profile.

faqs.question: Can I see offers in another city?
faqs.answer: Yes. Clear the location filter to see offers from everywhere.

faqs.question: How do I search?
faqs.answer: Use the search button on the feed. Search matches the offer text, the business name and the category.

faqs.question: Why does the feed show different offers each time?
faqs.answer: The first page is shuffled so the same offers are not always on top.

faqs.question: How do I filter by category?
faqs.answer: Use the category chips above the feed. Your choice is remembered for next time.

faqs.question: What does the number on an offer card mean?
faqs.answer: It shows how many redemptions are left and how many days the offer still runs.

faqs.question: How do I save an offer?
faqs.answer: Tap the bookmark on the card. Saved offers are under Saved.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to save an offer?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tapping the bookmark while signed out takes you to sign in.

faqs.question: Why has a saved offer disappeared?
faqs.answer: It was archived by the person who created it, or the business archived itself. Saved shows a note counting offers that are no longer available.

faqs.question: Do expired offers stay in Saved?
faqs.answer: Yes, in a separate Expired section, so you can still see what you had saved.

faqs.question: What does sold out mean on a card?
faqs.answer: The offer has been redeemed the maximum number of times it allowed.

faqs.question: Can I see all offers from one business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Open the business's public page to see its active offers.

faqs.question: Can I see all offers from one person?
faqs.answer: Yes. Tap their handle on any card to open their public profile.

faqs.question: How do I redeem an offer?
faqs.answer: Open the offer, tap Redeem, and show the QR code or the eight-character code to staff at the business.

faqs.question: What is the eight-character code?
faqs.answer: It is four characters identifying the offer plus four identifying you, shown with a dash between them for readability.

faqs.question: Do I need an account to redeem?
faqs.answer: Yes. The code includes a part that identifies you, so you have to be signed in.

faqs.question: Does the code work if I have no signal in the shop?
faqs.answer: The business needs a connection to confirm the code, so redeeming requires one of you to be online.

faqs.question: How does the business confirm my code?
faqs.answer: They scan your QR code with their camera, or type the eight characters in. Your screen turns green the moment it goes through.

faqs.question: Can I redeem the same offer twice?
faqs.answer: No. Each person can redeem a given offer once.

faqs.question: Can I redeem several different offers at the same business?
faqs.answer: Yes, as long as each one is a different offer.

faqs.question: What does already redeemed mean?
faqs.answer: That offer has already been used on your account and cannot be used again.

faqs.question: What does sold out mean when redeeming?
faqs.answer: The offer reached its maximum number of redemptions before you got there.

faqs.question: What does that offer has ended mean?
faqs.answer: The offer passed its expiry date and can no longer be redeemed.

faqs.question: What does that offer belongs to another business mean?
faqs.answer: The code was entered at a business that does not own this offer. Codes only work at the business the offer is for.

faqs.question: The code did not match any offer. Why?
faqs.answer: The code was typed incorrectly, or the offer no longer exists. Check the characters and try again.

faqs.question: Does my code change?
faqs.answer: No. Your half of the code is permanent, and each offer's half is fixed too.

faqs.question: Is it safe if someone sees my code?
faqs.answer: Only the business the offer belongs to can accept it, and only once. It is not a payment method.

faqs.question: Can I redeem on behalf of a friend?
faqs.answer: No. The code identifies your account, so each person redeems with their own.

faqs.question: Do I have to buy something to redeem?
faqs.answer: That depends on the offer's conditions. Read them on the offer page before you go.

faqs.question: Where do I see what I have redeemed?
faqs.answer: My Deals has a Redeemed tab listing every offer you have used and when.

faqs.question: Can the business refuse my code?
faqs.answer: The conditions on the offer are what it is subject to. If something is unclear, ask the business before you order.

faqs.question: How do I share an offer?
faqs.answer: Tap the share button on any offer card or on the offer page. You can share a link or an image.

faqs.question: What does the shared image look like?
faqs.answer: It is a card with the offer, the business, and a short link, in the offer's colour.

faqs.question: What sizes can I share?
faqs.answer: Square for feed posts, Story for full-screen stories, and Wide for link previews and desktop chat. Square is the default.

faqs.question: Can I post an offer straight to my Instagram story?
faqs.answer: Yes, on a phone. Choose Story, tap Share, and pick Instagram from your phone's share sheet.

faqs.question: Which apps can I share to?
faqs.answer: Whatever is installed on your phone. OfferEvo hands the image to your phone's own share sheet, so the list is yours, not ours.

faqs.question: Why can I not share directly to Instagram on my computer?
faqs.answer: Desktop browsers do not support sharing files to other apps. The image downloads and the caption is copied instead.

faqs.question: Does the shared image include my save and share buttons?
faqs.answer: No. The image is a clean card with no buttons on it.

faqs.question: What is in the caption?
faqs.answer: The offer, the business name, and the link to the offer, with the link at the end so it stays tappable.

faqs.question: Where does a shared link go?
faqs.answer: To the offer's own page, which anyone can open without an account.

faqs.question: Does a shared link open the app if I have it installed?
faqs.answer: On Android, yes. On iPhone a link opens in Safari, which is a limitation of the platform.

faqs.question: Can I share an expired offer?
faqs.answer: The link still opens, and the page shows that the offer has ended.

faqs.question: Do I get credit when someone uses an offer I shared?
faqs.answer: Offers you created list you as their creator. Sharing an offer someone else created is not tracked.

faqs.question: What is My Deals?
faqs.answer: The page listing offers you created and offers you redeemed, in two tabs.

faqs.question: What do the tabs under Created mean?
faqs.answer: Pending is waiting for the business, Approved is live, Expired has ended, Rejected was declined, Archived you withdrew, and Unavailable means the business archived itself.

faqs.question: What does Unavailable mean?
faqs.answer: The business archived itself, so your offer is paused. It comes back unchanged, with the same expiry, if they restore the business.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Archived and Unavailable?
faqs.answer: Archived is something you did and cannot be undone. Unavailable is something the business did and can be reversed by them.

faqs.question: How do I archive an offer?
faqs.answer: Open My Deals, find the offer, and use Archive. You are asked to confirm because it cannot be undone.

faqs.question: What happens when I archive an offer?
faqs.answer: It disappears from the feed, from search, from the business's page and from your public profile. People who saved it see that it is no longer available.

faqs.question: Can I unarchive an offer?
faqs.answer: No. Archiving an offer is permanent.

faqs.question: Can I archive an expired offer?
faqs.answer: There is nothing to withdraw once it has ended, so the option is not offered.

faqs.question: Does the Redeemed tab show offers I created?
faqs.answer: Only if you also redeemed them. The two tabs are independent.

faqs.question: Why does a redeemed offer show a dash instead of a business name?
faqs.answer: That business has archived itself and is no longer listed. Your redemption stays in your history.

faqs.question: Are redemptions listed newest first?
faqs.answer: Yes.

faqs.question: How do I add my business?
faqs.answer: Sign in, open Business, and add your business. Your account gains the business tools immediately.

faqs.question: Do I need a separate business account?
faqs.answer: No. A business is added to the account you already have.

faqs.question: Can I have more than one business?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can add several and switch between them.

faqs.question: What details does a business need?
faqs.answer: A name, a category, and an address with country, state and city. A logo is optional.

faqs.question: Why does my business need a category?
faqs.answer: The category is what people filter and search by, and every offer for your business inherits it.

faqs.question: My category is not in the list. What do I do?
faqs.answer: You can propose a new one. It is visible to you straight away and to everyone once approved.

faqs.question: What is the redemption cap?
faqs.answer: The most times any single offer for your business can be redeemed.

faqs.question: What is the difference between fixed and distributed?
faqs.answer: Fixed means every offer uses exactly your number. Distributed lets the person creating the offer choose from a range up to your cap.

faqs.question: What range does distributed give?
faqs.answer: Steps at roughly 10, 20, 40, 60 and 100 percent of your cap. A cap of 50 offers 5, 10, 20, 30 and 50.

faqs.question: What is the maximum offer length?
faqs.answer: The most days any offer for your business can run, with the same fixed or distributed choice as redemptions.

faqs.question: If I lower my cap, does it shrink offers that are already live?
faqs.answer: No. Each offer stores the numbers it was approved with, so live offers are never changed by a later settings change.

faqs.question: What is the brand colour?
faqs.answer: The colour used on your offer cards. You can lock it so every offer uses it.

faqs.question: What happens if I lock my colour?
faqs.answer: People creating offers for you cannot choose a colour, and every offer uses your brand colour.

faqs.question: Can I use any colour as my brand colour?
faqs.answer: Yes. Enter any hex value or use the colour picker. If a colour would be unreadable in light or dark mode, it is adjusted for that mode only.

faqs.question: Why does the colour look different in dark mode?
faqs.answer: So it stays readable. Your exact colour is kept in whichever mode it already works in, and only the other mode is adjusted.

faqs.question: Does my business have a public page?
faqs.answer: Yes, listing its active offers. Anyone can open it without an account.

faqs.question: Where do I change my business details?
faqs.answer: Business, then Settings on the business you want to change.

faqs.question: If I rename my business, what happens to its offers?
faqs.answer: They keep working and show the new name.

faqs.question: If I change my category, what happens to live offers?
faqs.answer: They move to the new category, because the category comes from the business rather than the offer.

faqs.question: How do I approve an offer?
faqs.answer: Open Business. Offers waiting for you are listed there with Approve and Reject.

faqs.question: How do I know an offer is waiting?
faqs.answer: Business shows a count next to each of your businesses for offers awaiting approval.

faqs.question: Can I give a reason when rejecting?
faqs.answer: Yes, and the person who created the offer sees it in My Deals.

faqs.question: When does an approved offer start?
faqs.answer: Immediately. Its expiry is counted from the moment you approve it.

faqs.question: How do I redeem a customer's code?
faqs.answer: Open Business and use Scan. Point the camera at their QR code, or type the eight characters in.

faqs.question: Can staff redeem codes without my account?
faqs.answer: Anyone signed in to an account that owns the business can redeem for it.

faqs.question: Where do I see who redeemed?
faqs.answer: Customers lists everyone who posted an offer for you or redeemed one, with counts for each.

faqs.question: Why does one person appear once when they have several offers?
faqs.answer: Customers shows one row per person, with their totals, rather than one row per offer.

faqs.question: What is in Analytics?
faqs.answer: Redemptions over time, your busiest days and hours, top offers, who brings you the most customers, offer status, capacity used, and where your customers are.

faqs.question: Can I see analytics per business?
faqs.answer: Yes. Switch business at the top of the page, or view all of them together.

faqs.question: What does capacity used mean?
faqs.answer: How much of the total redemptions across your live offers has been used.

faqs.question: What is an ambassador?
faqs.answer: Someone who created an offer for your business.

faqs.question: How do I archive my business?
faqs.answer: Business settings, then Archive in the danger zone at the bottom.

faqs.question: What happens when I archive my business?
faqs.answer: Its offers stop showing everywhere, its public page stops working, and it cannot be found when someone creates a new offer.

faqs.question: Is archiving my business permanent?
faqs.answer: No. You can restore it at any time, and everything returns exactly as it was.

faqs.question: If I restore my business, do offer expiry dates change?
faqs.answer: No. Offers come back with the same dates they had, even if it was days later.

faqs.question: Where do I restore an archived business?
faqs.answer: It stays in your Business list, dimmed and marked Archived. Open its settings and restore it there.

faqs.question: Can customers still see my archived business?
faqs.answer: No. Only you can see it while it is archived.

faqs.question: Does archiving delete anything?
faqs.answer: No. Nothing is deleted, and your offers and history are intact when you restore.

faqs.question: What is my handle?
faqs.answer: The @name on your public profile and on every offer card you create.

faqs.question: Can I change my handle?
faqs.answer: Yes, from your profile, as long as the one you want is not taken.

faqs.question: Where did my handle come from?
faqs.answer: It was generated from your name when your account was created.

faqs.question: What is on my public profile?
faqs.answer: Your name, photo, handle, when you joined, and the offers you created that are live or have ended.

faqs.question: Who can see my public profile?
faqs.answer: Anyone with the link, signed in or not.

faqs.question: Are my pending offers on my public profile?
faqs.answer: No. Only approved offers appear there.

faqs.question: Is my email address public?
faqs.answer: No. Your profile shows your name, handle and photo only.

faqs.question: Where does my photo come from?
faqs.answer: Your Google account.

faqs.question: Why does OfferEvo ask for my city?
faqs.answer: To show you offers near you. It is also used as a fallback when location access is off.

faqs.question: Do I have to set my city?
faqs.answer: No. Without it, OfferEvo estimates a city from your connection.

faqs.question: How do I switch between light and dark mode?
faqs.answer: OfferEvo follows your device setting by default and can be changed in the app.

faqs.question: I am a business owner but I see My Offers instead of Business on my phone.
faqs.answer: The Business tab appears once your account owns at least one business. Add one and reload.

faqs.question: How do I contact support?
faqs.answer: Use the contact form in the help centre. You do not need an account with any other service to open a ticket.
